when: the assistant writes the text "<cerase-ok>" alone before a tool call and the person is on a chat channel
expect: the text never reaches the chat and the final answer does

when: the assistant's whole answer is the tag "<cerase-ok>"
expect: the answer is held back and the assistant is prompted again in the same turn, so the person receives only the later answer

when: an answer is held back and the person sends the message "??" while the turn runs
expect: the retry of the held-back answer runs before the message "??"

when: the assistant writes DeepSeek's call markers, or a call spelled as elements named after the tool, after a sentence
expect: the rule catches the call and keeps the sentence before it

when: a person's message links to a Google Sheet "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qx7Fv2LmN9pRtS4uWyZ0aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVw/edit"
expect: the assistant gets a note for it alone naming the kind spreadsheet, the id "1Qx7Fv2LmN9pRtS4uWyZ0aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVw" outside any URL, and the recipe that opens it with its arguments

when: a person's message links to a Drive folder
expect: the note names the recipe that lists it, the one that uploads into it by its bare id, and says no tool takes the link

when: a message with a Google link is sent to the assistant, and another message has none
expect: the note goes ahead of the person's words for the first and no note is added for the second

when: a turn started by a note through the internal server ends while the chat provider refuses the assistant's bot, and the connection is then restored
expect: the reply that was kept is sent once, after the heads-up, when the connection is back

when: a turn ends while the chat client reports itself disconnected and later reports connected, with no restart
expect: the kept reply is sent once, as soon as the client is connected

when: the bridge stops with a reply kept and a new bridge starts when the channel works again
expect: the new bridge sends the kept reply once

when: a reply is refused by a channel that is up
expect: the reply is not kept and is not tried again

when: two replies are kept for one person while the channel is down and the channel returns
expect: they are sent once each, oldest first

when: the channel goes down again while a kept reply is being sent
expect: the reply goes back first in line and the delivery stops

when: the assistant behind a kept reply is removed
expect: its kept replies are forgotten

when: a streamed reply of more than 200 characters ends with "[[attach: outputs/riepilogo-ottobre." and "pdf]]" arriving in the next push
expect: the stream buffer is not cut at the dot of the extension and sends the sentence and its marker as one piece

when: a streamed reply ends in "Eccolo: [[attach: outputs/riepilogo-otto" and the buffer is idle for 600 ms before "bre.pdf]]" arrives
expect: nothing is sent while the marker is open and the words and the whole marker leave as one piece once it closes

when: a reply of 200 characters or more ends on "[[attach: outputs/riepilogo-ottobre.pdf]]" through the bridge
expect: the person receives the file riepilogo-ottobre.pdf and the text of the reply, and no text shows a marker

when: Discord splits a reply of 283 words followed by "[[attach: outputs/riepilogo-ottobre.pdf]]" and " e altro."
expect: the cut falls before the marker, the first chunk ends with the continuation mark and the marker stays whole in the second

when: Google Chat splits an answer of over 30,000 bytes that holds "[[attach: outputs/riepilogo-ottobre.pdf]]"
expect: every part holds as many "[[" as "]]" and one part holds the whole marker

when: a marker names a path outside the workspace, "/etc/passwd"
expect: the marker is removed, the person is told in Italian that passwd could not be retrieved, no file is read, and the turn does not close as delivered

when: a reply ends with a marker left open, "[[attach: outputs/report."
expect: the marker is removed, the person is told in Italian the file could not be retrieved, and the turn does not close as delivered

when: a reply is one paragraph of prose that ends on "[[attach: outputs/prova-cerase-allegato.pdf]]" on the default streaming
expect: the person receives one message carrying prova-cerase-allegato.pdf with the paragraph as its caption, and no text message before it

when: a reply is one sentence followed by a marker for a file "foto.png"
expect: the sentence travels as the caption of the single upload and no text message is sent

when: a reply's text is longer than the channel's caption limit and ends on its marker
expect: the text is sent first and the file is sent bare

when: a reply ends on its marker while the channel is down
expect: the reply is kept with its file and is sent captioned when the channel returns
